attributes.name: SmoothTime
attributes.helptext: Time required to approach the input specified in game units (usually seconds). Because the system is implemented as a damped spring the SmoothTime is the expected lag of the result behind a constantly changing input.

attributes.name: SmoothVelocity
attributes.helptext: True has a smoothly changing velocity, it acts as a critically damped spring. False is only smooth in position, an exponential decay towards the input

attributes.name: UseInitValueOnInit
attributes.helptext: Set True to use the InitValue to set the operator's value on initialisation.  False will make the operator use the input control parameter value on initialisation.

helptext: Smoothly approach a value over time
